fields.notes: InfiniBand's test surface is in-band management (SMPs on QP0/VL15, GMPs on QP1) plus PortCounters and the VCRC/ICRC + PSN telemetry. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain implementation concerns; interoperability is established by IBTA Plugfests.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Subnet Management (SMP / QP0 / VL15)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read/write PortInfo/NodeInfo, forwarding tables, SL-to-VL, VL arb — in-band controllability/observability.

in_band_test_facilities.name: General Services (GMP / QP1)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: PortCounters, Communication Management, Subnet Administration, Device Management.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Performance counters
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Symbol errors, link recovery, received/transmitted data + packets per port.

in_band_test_facilities.name: VCRC / ICRC
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-hop and end-to-end error detection telemetry.

out_of_band_test_facilities: IBTA Plugfest / Integrators' List interoperability testing.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
